oneLine: Mandatory open offer announced for Avishkar Infra Realty.

sources.title: Avishkar Infra Realty Mandatory Open Offer: Key Dates and Terms

synopsis: A mandatory open offer has been announced for shares of Avishkar Infra Realty following a share purchase agreement with an existing promoter, Kapil Jeetendra Kothari, and a linked preferential allotment. The acquirer group, led by Nalin Ramaniklal Shah along with ten persons acting in concert, will acquire a significant holding and expects to be reclassified as promoters. The public announcement was made on 14 October 2026, with a detailed statement following on 22 October 2026. The independent directors' committee recommendation is expected by 7 December 2026, and the tendering period is scheduled to run from 9 December to 22 December 2026, subject to SEBI review. Participation in the cash-settled offer is optional for public shareholders.
